newsitem.title: USA: Rehabilicare says European tentative pact expires.
newsitem.headline: Rehabilicare says European tentative pact expires.

text.p: Rehabilicare Inc said Friday it was unable to reach terms on a European distribution agreement with a German company.
"We were unable to reach agreement on pricing and terms and therefore will not enter into a definitive agreement," said Rehabilicare president David Kaysen in a statement.
Rehabilicare had signed a letter of intent for European distribution of the company's pain management and rehabilitation products with B. Braun of Melsungen, Germany. The letter has expired.
"We had signed this letter of intent as part of our long-term strategy to broaden our international business," he said.
Rehabilicare said it had expected very little revenue from B. Braun in fiscal 1998 and is actively pursuing several other options for international distribution of its products.
Rehabilicare designs and makes electromedical pain management and rehabilitation products and services used for clinical, home health care and occupational medicine.
Shares of Rehabilicare were trading up 5/16 to 3-5/16.
